name: 1999-08-11 total eclipse — NASA published Besselian elements

local_observer.name: Romania — near central line benchmark point

source_notes: NASA GSFC publishes the 11:00:00 TDT Besselian epoch, greatest eclipse at 11:04:09.1 TDT, Delta-T=63.7 s, and the polynomial coefficients. The central-line check interpolates the NASA path-table rows at 11:03 UT and 11:04 UT to the UT1 instant corresponding to the computed TT maximum. The local observer is a regression point close to the central line, not a survey-grade station. The duration tolerance accounts for this offset and rounded table values.
